lede_html: Samuel's hand-drawn pipeline (note /Inkpartnertest p. 3) as a diagram, compared node by node with the state of watch/write-gap: what each step does, whether the sketch still holds, which session or commit changed it, which rule applies and what is still open. subtitle_html: Note /Inkpartnertest p. 3, 25 Oct 2026, 00:30 Berlin time · code state watch/write-gap @ 0bfccb4
footer: Source: flow.en.json (translated from flow.json) · GRILLME_notizen.md · as of 25 Oct 2026
points: `agent.read` renders only the student's ink as one image → VLM

`read()` returns `(subject, elements)`. Element kinds: line, formula, code, text, node, edge, arrow, box, table, drawing, printed; no "image"/"question". Requests for help are detected by `asks_for_help`. "Recognize first, then prompt" (9ba24a5) is local only, not on GitHub
`profiles.py`: math, code, diagram, pm, prose with judge prompt, marks, max_actions
Subject math / kind calculation → VLM with prompt template
Math profile (sympy as checker): yes; a separate "kind" (calculation) does not exist
Output: proposal → verdict = boolean, mark = correction mark
The verdict has 5 values: correct, wrong, hint, help, unreadable; the colour follows the verdict (`marks.COLOR`)
Math: 6 marks (check, underline, circle, wavy = unreadable, ?, text)
`ALL_MARKS` = check, underline, circle, wavy, question, note (same on main and write-gap)
`max_actions=4` (default, applies to math); pm/prose 3; plus at most 1 help note per round
`--interval` default 1.5 s. New since 0bfccb4: 10 s R-COOLDOWN after every write, 45 s model timeout in the watcher (previously 600 s)
There is no judge.py: the judge is `agent.judge` (agent.py), the flow lives in `review.run`
No validate.py; `plan.validate()` in plan.py. "Too strict": according to the sessions, R-VIEWPORT 0.00 and R-RATE blocked; R-PEN-NEAR switched off in 0bfccb4 with `if False`
Inputs: judge proposals + element list + subject profile
Diamond yes → collected + sorted by priority → draw; no → rejected list
`out.accepted.sort` (help < wrong < unreadable < hint < correct), `out.rejected` with reason
draw: mark → pixels at element position, student vs. agent ink, stroke dictionary
`draw.py` (new in 0bfccb4) returns `list[dict]` strokes with action key; still in plan.py on main
Delivery → virtual pen → RM, SSH Tablet.send
Over SSH to /dev/input. main: `cat`; write-gap and planck: `dd bs=24 iflag=fullblock` (37dd2e8, 0bfccb4)
After writing: notes app / native device editor
Reference is ambiguous. The file route with an xochitl restart still exists as a fallback (`systemctl stop xochitl …`)
`.rm` is read via `ssh cat`; several `return None` in watch.py
Code: pending + retry_pending, pen pause after 2 failures; escalation after the Codex session on 23 Oct (watch.py ~595)
